summary: Tested Stripe donation APIs and persistence, unpaid Stripe poll-through, donation UI/redirect/polling/cancel flows, Framer Motion reveals/transitions, sticky glass navbar, desktop/mobile navigation, and map/sponsor/login/admin regressions. Core donation and animation flows work. Full backend suite: 21/24 passed; failures are anonymous admin-donations status mismatch plus existing CORS and brute-force defects. Frontend defects: feature cards do not lift on hover, and donation-package load failures are silently hidden.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout: six invalid logins return 401; attempt six should return 429 after five failures.
Credentialed CORS still permits an arbitrary Origin and returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

minor.issue: Anonymous request returns 401 Not authenticated, while the requested contract specifies 403 without an admin token. A regular-user token correctly returns 403, and an admin token correctly returns the donation array.

ui_bugs.issue: Hover changes the border to green but does not apply translateY(-2px); computed transform remains none.

integration_issues.issue: When GET /api/donations/packages returns 500, the page silently renders zero package cards, shows no error/retry state, and leaves Continue to Stripe enabled with the hidden default package selection.

action_items: Move feature-card hover lift into Framer Motion (for example whileHover={{ y: -2 }}) or otherwise avoid the motion element's inline transform overriding the CSS hover transform.
Add loading, visible error, and retry states for donation packages; disable checkout until a package response succeeds.
Align anonymous /api/admin/donations behavior with the requested 403 contract, or explicitly revise the contract to standard 401 for unauthenticated and 403 for authenticated non-admin users.
Add failed-login tracking/rate limiting and return 429 after five failures.
Configure an explicit CORS origin allowlist when allow_credentials is enabled.
Validate donation origin_url against an environment-configured frontend allowlist and use Pydantic URL/email types; do not accept an arbitrary redirect origin.
critical_code_review_comments: StaggerItem is a motion.div and Framer Motion leaves an inline transform:none after reveal; this has higher priority than .pz-card-hoverable:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) }, causing the reproduced hover-lift failure.
Donate.jsx swallows package/stats API failures with empty catch handlers. The checkout remains actionable even when no package was loaded.

DonateIn declares origin_url and donor_email as unrestricted strings. origin_url is directly used for Stripe success/cancel redirects, creating an open-redirect risk; validate against configured application origins and use AnyHttpUrl/EmailStr.
STRIPE_API_KEY and ADMIN_PASSWORD have hardcoded fallback values. Credentials should be required from environment variables and fail fast when missing.
Public checkout creation has no request throttling, allowing unbounded Stripe test-session and Mongo record creation.
server.py is 776 lines and should be split into focused auth, donations, sponsors, bins, and admin modules.
Donation package cards use role=button without tabIndex or keyboard handlers, so they are not keyboard-equivalent controls.
seed_data_creation: Created Stripe test checkout sessions for backend and UI redirect/polling verification without completing payment. All TEST donation Mongo records were deleted; no payment was completed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Donation packages, invalid package 400, checkout URL/session prefixes, initiated/pending Mongo persistence, Stripe pending poll-through (with no Stripe status warning in backend logs), stats, admin-token list, regular-user 403, and invalid webhook signature 400 passed. UI verified 4 cards, default 5kg, selection change, POST payload, Stripe redirect target, unpaid polling attempt 1 to 2, cancel actions, mobile/desktop Donate links, sticky frosted navbar, 1.05-to-1 image reveals, upward feature re-trigger/stagger, active/hover button feedback, and route exit/enter animation. /map, sponsors/detail, login, and admin regressions passed. Added test IDs only to donate success/cancel actions.
rca_of_the_issue: Feature lift fails because Framer Motion owns the inline transform on the same element, overriding CSS hover transform. Donation outage UX fails because both package and stats promises use catch(() => {}) and no loading/error state gates checkout. Anonymous admin donations returns 401 in get_current_user before require_admin can return 403. CORS and lockout failures remain caused by wildcard CORS configuration and absent failed-attempt tracking.
